mapper.sql: SELECT j.batch_job_id::TEXT AS row_id, j.job_cd, j.name, j.description, j.cron_expr, j.auto_yn, j.sort_no::TEXT AS sort_no, TO_CHAR(j.upd_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS upd_dt, j.upd_id, l.status_cd AS last_status_cd, c.name AS last_status_name, l.manual_yn AS last_manual_yn, TO_CHAR(l.start_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_start_dt, TO_CHAR(l.end_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_end_dt, l.result_msg AS last_result_msg FROM batch_job j LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT b.status_cd, b.manual_yn, b.start_dt, b.end_dt, b.result_msg FROM batch_log b WHERE b.job_cd = j.job_cd ORDER BY b.batch_log_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) l ON TRUE LEFT JOIN code c ON c.code_id = l.status_cd AND c.p_code_id = 'BATCH00'
mapper.update: UPDATE batch_job SET cron_expr = #{cronExpr}, auto_yn = #{autoYn}, upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE batch_job_id = #{rowId}::integer
